# Mr. Mythical

> Mythic+ and raid tools for World of Warcraft, plus free in-game addons for keystones, DPS gearing, and prep checks.

Mr. Mythical helps players plan Mythic+ keys, read Warcraft Logs, check boss damage profiles, and install related WoW addons from CurseForge or Wago.

## Web tools

- [Home](https://mrmythical.com/): Overview of the Mythic+ score calculator, Battle.net farm priority, raid log visualizer, boss profiles, and addons
- [Mythic+ Score Calculator](https://mrmythical.com/rating-calculator): Set a target rating and see which keystones get you there
- [Farm Priority](https://mrmythical.com/gearing): Load a character from Battle.net and rank Midnight Season 2 dungeon and raid loot immediately in the browser. Same SimC-trained DPS estimator as the addon, not a full sim
- [Raid Log Visualizer](https://mrmythical.com/raid): Paste a Warcraft Logs report for per-second damage and healing
- [Boss Damage & Death Profiles](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss): Heroic and Mythic Venomous Abyss guides plus averaged Mythic damage curves. Ula'tek was not on PTR
- [Nek'zali the Soulcoiler](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/nekzali-the-soulcoiler): Heroic Venomous Abyss opener
- [Nek'zali the Soulcoiler (Mythic)](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/nekzali-the-soulcoiler/mythic): Mythic well teams and Uncoiled Rage
- [Entombed Sentinels](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/entombed-sentinels): Heroic split-golem Stasis plan
- [Entombed Sentinels (Mythic)](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/entombed-sentinels/mythic): Mythic Protovenom pairing
- [The Lost Explorers](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/the-lost-explorers): Heroic Disgusting Fish feeds
- [The Lost Explorers (Mythic)](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/the-lost-explorers/mythic): Mythic Relic Rupture crate stomps
- [Vashnik the Malignant](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/vashnik-the-malignant): Heroic fountain Imbibe
- [Vashnik the Malignant (Mythic)](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/vashnik-the-malignant/mythic): Mythic tumors and Plague Wave
- [Sszorak](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/sszorak): Heroic wind knockbacks and Dig In
- [Sszorak (Mythic)](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/sszorak/mythic): Mythic Serpent's Fury soak
- [The Twin Fangs](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/the-twin-fangs): Heroic Eternal Venom and Feast
- [The Twin Fangs (Mythic)](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/the-twin-fangs/mythic): Mythic Tainted Blood soaks
- [The Coiled Altar](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/the-coiled-altar): Heroic Zul'jan into Malacrass
- [The Coiled Altar (Mythic)](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/the-coiled-altar/mythic): Mythic Virulent Mutation and Soulbinding
- [Ula'tek](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/ulatek): Not on PTR, guide coming as soon as the fight is tested
- [Ula'tek (Mythic)](https://mrmythical.com/raid/boss/ulatek/mythic): Not on PTR, Mythic guide coming as soon as the fight is tested
- [About](https://mrmythical.com/about): Project background and contact

## WoW addons

- [All addons](https://mrmythical.com/addons): Mr. Mythical addon suite for World of Warcraft
- [Mythic+ Dashboard & Tooltips](https://mrmythical.com/addons/dashboard): Customizable keystone tooltips for rewards, crests, score gains, and timers, plus a planning dashboard
- [DPS Predictor & Gearing Dashboard](https://mrmythical.com/addons/dps-predictor): In-game gearing dashboard for bag loadouts, season scans, crest plans, and Great Vault. Typical scans finish immediately, with SimulationCraft-trained DPS
- [Leaderboard](https://mrmythical.com/addons/leaderboard): Top Raider.IO Mythic+ runs on keystone tooltips
- [Gear Check](https://mrmythical.com/addons/gear-check): Group checks for enchants, gems, and durability
- [Assistant](https://mrmythical.com/addons/assistant): Unicorn companion with run commentary and optional keystone insert
